title: Biochemistry
content: Biochemistry is the study of matter and the chemical processes of living organisms.

title: Chemical Engineering
content: Chemical Engineering is a branch of science and engineering that applies chemistry, physics, and mathematics to design and operate industrial chemical processes.

title: Environmental Sciences
content: Environmental Sciences is an interdisciplinary field that studies the environment and solutions to environmental problems, heavily relying on chemical principles.

title: Materials Science
content: Materials Science is an area of study that focuses on the properties, structure, and applications of matter such as metals, polymers, and semi-conductors.

title: Nuclear Science
content: Nuclear Science is the study of the reactions, properties, and applications involving atomic nuclei and radioactivity.
